info.title: DuckCorp API
info.description: A multiplayer idle game API where players build a rubber duck empire, produce ducks and sell them on the market.

get.description: Check whether the API process is running and able to answer requests.
Get the API version exposed by the running process.
Get the catalog of storage units that increase the player's duck capacity.

post.description: Purchase one storage unit for the authenticated player and return the updated storage capacity.

get.description: Get the authenticated player's complete gameplay state after processing offline production.

post.description: Synchronize the authenticated player by applying offline duck production.

get.description: Get the authenticated player's purchased buildings and their production values.
Get the authenticated player's purchased storage units and capacity values.
Get the current market price used when selling ducks.

post.description: Sell all ducks owned by the authenticated player at the current market price.

get.description: Get the last 100 computed market prices for charts and trend displays.
Get a paginated leaderboard sorted by ducks, money, production, storage capacity, building count, or storage count.

parameters.description: The criteria to sort the leaderboard by (default: byDucks)
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: The number of players to return per page (default: 10)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get the authenticated player's rank in every leaderboard category.
Get the public game configuration used by clients.
Get the catalog of buildings that players can purchase to increase duck production.

post.description: Purchase one building for the authenticated player and return the updated building amount and production.

Register a new player account.
The response includes the bearer token used to authenticate player routes.

get.description: Get the profile of the authenticated player from the bearer token.

delete.description: Delete the authenticated player's account and progress.

get.description: Get a public player profile by ID. This route does not expose money, ducks, token, or private progress data.

post.description: Authenticate as an administrator and receive the bearer token required for admin routes.

get.description: Get the current game configuration, including starting values and market tuning.

put.description: Update one or more game configuration values and persist them to disk.

get.description: Get a paginated list of players

parameters.description: The number of players to return per page (default: 10)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get complete gameplay and account details for one player by ID.

delete.description: Delete a player account and return the deleted player's identity.

post.description: Reset a player's progress to default game values while keeping the account.
Replace a player's money amount with an exact non-negative value.
Replace a player's duck amount with an exact non-negative value.
Add a non-negative amount of money to a player.
Add a non-negative amount of ducks to a player.
Remove a non-negative amount of money from a player.
Remove a non-negative amount of ducks from a player.
Ban an IP address from accessing the API.
Remove a ban from an IP address.

get.description: Get global game totals and host resource statistics for the admin dashboard.

Get every achievement available in the game.
Use this route to display the achievement catalog, including locked
achievements that the authenticated player has not unlocked yet.
